old_name_record.name: BSP_LoadingScreen_ReportProgress
old_name_record.evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frontend_shell_entry, read-only analysis. __stdcall(float progress), RET 4, no ECX; a null 00E194B4 is a no-op (0057bec9). Raises screen+30h to max(screen+30h, progress) and screen+2Ch to max(screen+2Ch, LIBCRT 00bf7420 counter); neither is ever lowered (0057bf04 JG then 0057bf06 JZ). x87 checked on disk: 0057beef FMUL qword [00CEF258] (=128.0) leaves its product in ST0 and it is never stored, because 0057bef5 is an SSE MOVSS of the unscaled maximum; ST0 is also left loaded on return. Ghidra and the raw decoder agree, so the dead multiply and x87 stack leak are in the shipped code. Sole non-trivial caller 004e4000 at 004e413a with the 0.1f at 00D7A2F0. Evidence: docs/GAME_FRONTEND_ENTRY.md.

Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet loading_screen_elements, read-only analysis. __fastcall(this), RET 0. Called at 0057CE83 for every mode; it is LoadingScreenHost::prepare_extra_elements of include/bsp/frontend_entry.hpp. Clears +30h to 0.0f, +2Ch to -1 and +50h to 0.0f; sets the per-hint progress step +4Ch to 1.0f/(float)(unsigned)N over the published key vector at 00E08784..00E0878C, or to the 200.0 of 00CE4D70 when the vector is empty (0057C9C9 adds the 2^32 of 00CE3978, so the count is unsigned); rewinds the cursor 00E0877C to -1; calls 0057C360 then tail-jumps 0057C4C0 at 0057C9F1. docs/LOADING_SCREEN_ELEMENTS.md
